brand_source.rule: Android preserves the RedactGuard visual identity while using Android-native interaction and adaptive layout patterns. Desktop layout mechanics are not copied literally.

assets.android_owned_copy: pending binary asset transfer in RGUX-1; do not invent a second RedactGuard mark

tokens.typography: Desktop visual source is Inter. Android uses the platform sans-serif fallback through the canonical Compose typography owner until an explicitly licensed Inter font resource is repository-owned; weights and hierarchy match the RedactGuard brand rather than bundling an untracked font binary.
tokens.radius: 6/8/12/16/24 dp semantic shapes; primary cards use 16 dp and infrequent hero/outcome surfaces may use 24 dp
tokens.elevation: quiet and low; grouping and cool layered surfaces precede shadow. Use tonal/surface hierarchy before raised decoration.

style.direction: Quiet Professional: clean, blue, private, document-centric and professional; avoid cyber/neon visual language and generic enterprise grey.
style.iconography: Android-native outline icons when they improve scanning or action recognition. The RedactGuard shield mark is brand, not a generic status icon. Never use color or an icon alone for critical meaning.
style.motion: quiet, functional and brief; motion communicates feedback, continuity, progress or meaningful completion and never delays a privacy/recovery action
style.imagery: functional-before-decorative; shield/document graphics may reinforce local protection but the workflow remains understandable without illustration
style.voice_microcopy: calm, direct Italian task language; explain what remains local, avoid Harness/Binder/model vocabulary on normal surfaces, state known failures and next actions without alarmism

durations.large: 300 ms maximum for infrequent navigation/meaningful completion

spring.default: medium-low stiffness, no visible overshoot for task UI
spring.bounce: n/a - decorative bounce is not part of the RedactGuard motion language

motion_tokens.reduced_motion_strategy: replace non-essential animated transitions with immediate state changes; never remove acknowledgement, progress text or outcome feedback
